# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test data and fixtures for various platforms.

## Platform Samples

- `chatgpt-samples/` - ChatGPT conversation outputs
- `claude-samples/` - Claude conversation outputs
- `gemini-samples/` - Gemini conversation outputs
- `deepseek-samples/` - DeepSeek outputs
- `markdown-samples/` - Generic Markdown code blocks

Each fixture includes:
- Raw HTML/text from the platform
- Expected extraction results
- Edge cases and error scenarios
